_note: Public site builder (30 Oct). Decision D15 (public marketing site) resolved: the founder asked for the whole blueprint, so SC-001..006, SC-008 and SC-013 are built as public pages. '/' is unchanged (founder's prototype start) and links to /site.

SC-001.note: Promise ('Evidence-first hiring, with Q doing the work.'), an entry for each side, both founder promises verbatim, 'what Q will never do', and an honest 'where this is today'. Q is present as the inline sample conversation (SC-013). Loading/error/permission states live in the sample Q; the list alternative is /site/ask.

SC-002.note: Audience switch (radio group, ?for=talent in the address, warm candidate paper) and a working demonstration beside each step: approve criteria, evidence classes, one targeted follow-up, receipts (accepted ≠ delivered ≠ read), sharing on/off, private practice. All fictional and labelled Sample or Simulated send.

SC-003.note: Outcomes stated without promising results; a 5-step sample journey (the founder's Tobi/Seyi example, fictional) with criteria, why Tobi isn't dropped, the per-criterion comparison with sources, one bounded follow-up and a simulated send; who it's for (in-house, agency, occasional founder); trust block.

SC-004.note: 'Show what you can do, even if your CV doesn't.' Candidate outcomes, the four evidence classes in the same words employers see, growth between applications (practice is private, never proof), free to apply and to be found.

SC-005.note: Role pilot ($99–$299), team plan ($149–$399/team/month), agency plan ($299–$799/month or per mandate), candidate core free — every price labelled a hypothesis being tested, from 01_BUYER_EVIDENCE_AND_PRICING.md. Compare table (mandate / seat / agents / assessment) says 'not decided' instead of numbers; phone shows a list. No payment fields. 'Ask about this' records interest in the store (areas.public.interest); nothing is sent. Value check labelled a model, not a quote. Signed-in Q answers 'how much does Talent Q cost' (q/skills/public.ts).

SC-006.note: What Q does and does not decide, human review, the five evidence classes (shared vocabulary), privacy and revocation, simulated vs real (receipts), no face/accent/emotion/personality scoring, and the ledger's six unproven claims as 'claims we don't make'. In-page index.

SC-008.note: Email code (passwordless, code 123456), Google and Microsoft, all simulated and labelled. Sets the session actor, records auth.signed_in in the actor's org/person scope, and lands on /r/home or /c/home (agency home via the recruiter home). States: sending, waiting for provider, incomplete email, unknown email, wrong code, cancelled, permission denied (Talentbridge requires Microsoft; simulated org rule), unfinished account → /signup. No password option (deliberate: passwordless).

SC-013.note: Sample Q on every public page: inline on the landing, an 'Ask Q' dock (desktop side panel, phone full sheet) with a page-aware opener elsewhere, full page at /site/ask. Rule-matched written answers, each labelled 'Sample answer'; fictional people labelled. Refuses real people/search (permission denied), says accuracy and results are not proven, gives prices as hypotheses, leads to /signup and /sign-in. States: empty (opener + questions), thinking (labelled), offline (question kept, Retry), fallback, and a list of every answer as the accessible alternative. Kept per tab (sessionStorage). Text only; no voice.
